description: After `style`, for the moves that matter: follows one element through a window at the full frame rate (subpixel template matching) and fits the exact timing of each property that moves (x, y, scale, opacity): a cubic-bezier, a spring (stiffness, damping, mass) when it overshoots or swings, linear or steps, with the fit error, duration in frames and delay. Window: `move` (a style move number) or `start`/`end`; element: `auto` (the biggest moving region) or a box at time `at`. Writes tracks.json, TRACK.md and an SVG of the curves, and adds the tracked move to motion-spec.json, so `export` uses the exact curve.

at.description: Time at which the box is drawn (default the window start).

element.description: `auto`, or the element's box {x, y, w, h} (top-left and size) in source pixels, or in fractions of the frame when every value is at most 1.

end.description: Window end (at most 15 s after start).

move.description: A move from `style` (1 = the first in motion-spec.json); sets the window with some rest around it.

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

start.description: Window start (default: just before the style move).

name: track
title: Track an element and fit its exact curve
